Mash the sweet potatoes in a large mixing bowl until smooth, ensuring no lumps.
Add the chopped curly parsley and oat flour to the mashed sweet potatoes and mix well.
Optional: Add an egg for binding if the mixture is crumbly.
Shape the mixture into small balls, rectangles, or press into cookie cutters for fun shapes.
Place the shaped treats on a parchment-lined baking sheet with space between each one.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until firm but chewy, avoiding overbaking to maintain softness.
Let the treats cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 4 žlice zobenog brašna (ili drugog brašna sigurnog za pse)
1 veliko jaje (po želji, da se smjesa poveže)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C. Operi i oguli batat i nareži ga na komade.
Kuhaj batat na pari ili u vodi dok vilica lako ne prođe kroz njega, oko 15–20 minuta.
U velikoj zdjeli zgnječi batat u glatki pire bez grudica.
Zgnječenom batatu dodaj nasjeckani kovrčavi peršin i zobeno brašno i dobro promiješaj.
Po želji: ako se smjesa mrvi, dodaj jaje da je poveže.
Oblikuj smjesu u male kuglice ili pravokutnike ili je utisni u modlice za zabavne oblike.
Složi poslastice na lim obložen papirom za pečenje, s razmakom između njih.
Peci 20–25 minuta dok ne postanu čvrste, ali žilave; nemoj ih prepeći da ostanu mekane.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se poslastice potpuno ohlade.

th: Pizza od jabuke i maslaca od kikirikija
i: 180 g whole wheat flour (or oat flour)
1 medium-sized apple, chopped (seeds and core removed)
Optional: shredded carrots, spinach leaves, or parsley for extra toppings
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, egg, unsweetened applesauce, and olive oil. Mix until a dough forms. If the dough is too dry, add water, one tablespoon at a time.
Dust a work surface lightly with flour and roll out the dough to about 6 mm thickness. Shape it into a pizza circle or use cookie cutters for fun shapes.
Place the rolled-out dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Pre-bake the crust for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the crust is baking, prepare the peanut butter spread.
Remove the crust from the oven and let it cool slightly. Spread 2 tbsp of homemade peanut butter evenly across the crust.
Sprinkle the chopped apple pieces and any additional optional toppings like shredded carrots or spinach.
Place the pizza back in the oven and bake for another 8-10 minutes, until the peanut butter is warm and the apples are slightly softened.
Allow the pizza to cool completely before slicing and serving it to your dog.
ih: 180 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili zobenog brašna)
1 srednja jabuka, nasjeckana (bez sjemenki i jezgre)
Po želji: naribana mrkva, listići špinata ili peršin za dodatni ukras
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj integralno pšenično brašno, jaje, nezaslađeni pire od jabuke i maslinovo ulje. Miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto. Ako je tijesto presuho, dodaj vode, po jednu žlicu.
Lagano pobrašni radnu površinu i razvaljaj tijesto na debljinu od oko 6 mm. Oblikuj ga u krug za pizzu ili modlicama izreži zabavne oblike.
Stavi razvaljano tijesto na lim obložen papirom za pečenje. Najprije peci samu podlogu 10–12 minuta ili dok ne porumeni.
Dok se podloga peče, pripremi namaz od kikirikija.
Izvadi podlogu iz pećnice i pusti da se malo ohladi. Ravnomjerno je premaži s 2 žlice domaćeg maslaca od kikirikija.
Pospi nasjeckanom jabukom i dodacima po želji, npr. naribanom mrkvom ili špinatom.
Vrati pizzu u pećnicu i peci još 8–10 minuta, dok se maslac od kikirikija ne zagrije, a jabuka malo ne omekša.
Pusti da se pizza potpuno ohladi, pa je nareži i posluži psu.

th: Keksi od zobi, sira i jabuke, bez pšenice
i: 120 g unsweetened applesauce or pumpkin puree
2 tbsp water (if needed for dough consistency)
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl, combine 480 ml of oat flour and 240 ml of shredded cheese, mixing thoroughly.
Add 1 egg and 120 ml of unsweetened applesauce or pumpkin puree to the dry ingredients. Stir until a dough forms. If too dry, gradually add water.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to 6 mm thickness and cut into desired shapes.
Place biscuits on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow to cool completely on a wire rack before serving.
ih: 120 g nezaslađenog pirea od jabuke ili pirea od bundeve
2 žlice vode (po potrebi, za gustoću tijesta)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U velikoj zdjeli dobro pomiješaj 480 ml zobenog brašna i 240 ml naribanog sira.
U suhe sastojke dodaj 1 jaje i 120 ml nezaslađenog pirea od jabuke ili bundeve. Miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto. Ako je presuho, postupno dodaj vode.
Razvaljaj tijesto na lagano pobrašnjenoj površini na debljinu od 6 mm i izreži oblike po želji.
Složi kekse na pripremljeni lim i peci 20–25 minuta ili dok ne porumene.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se potpuno ohlade na rešetki.

th: Keksi od banane i maslaca od kikirikija
i: 240 g whole wheat flour (or oat flour)
p: Preheat the oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
In a large bowl, mash the ripe banana until smooth. Add the peanut butter and honey (if using) and mix well.
Gradually add the flour to the wet mixture, mixing with a spoon, then knead with your hands to form a firm dough. Add water one tablespoon at a time if needed.
Sprinkle flour on a clean surface and roll out the dough to about 6 mm thickness. Cut out shapes with cookie cutters.
Place the shaped dough on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the biscuits to cool completely on a wire rack before serving to your dog.
ih: 130 g neslanog maslaca od kikirikija bez šećera
240 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili zobenog brašna)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje ili silikonskom podlogom.
U velikoj zdjeli zgnječi zrelu bananu dok ne postane glatka. Dodaj maslac od kikirikija i med (ako ga koristiš) i dobro promiješaj.
Postupno dodaj brašno u mokru smjesu i miješaj žlicom, a zatim mijesi rukama dok ne dobiješ čvrsto tijesto. Po potrebi dodaj vode, po jednu žlicu.
Pospi čistu površinu brašnom i razvaljaj tijesto na debljinu od oko 6 mm. Modlicama izreži oblike.
Složi oblike na pripremljeni lim i peci 20–25 minuta ili dok ne porumene.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se keksi potpuno ohlade na rešetki.

th: Keksi od mrkve i maslaca od kikirikija
i: 120 g whole wheat flour (or gluten-free alternative)
55 g grated carrots (about one medium carrot)
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl, combine the peanut butter and 60 ml of water, stirring until smooth.
Add the grated carrots to the peanut butter mixture and mix until evenly combined.
Gradually add the flour to the wet mixture, stirring until a dough forms. Add water by the teaspoon if needed to reach a pliable consistency.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to about 6 mm thickness and cut into shapes using cookie cutters or a knife.
Place the shaped biscuits on the prepared baking sheet, leaving a bit of space between each biscuit.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the edges are golden brown. For a crunchier texture, leave the biscuits to cool inside the oven with the door slightly open.
Remove the biscuits and let them cool completely on a wire rack before serving.
ih: 120 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili zamjene bez glutena)
130 g prirodnog maslaca od kikirikija (neslanog, bez ksilitola)
55 g naribane mrkve (oko jedne srednje mrkve)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U zdjeli miješaj maslac od kikirikija i 60 ml vode dok ne postane glatko.
Dodaj naribanu mrkvu u smjesu s maslacem od kikirikija i miješaj dok se ravnomjerno ne sjedini.
Postupno dodaj brašno u mokru smjesu i miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto. Po potrebi dodaj vode, po žličicu, da tijesto bude podatno.
Na lagano pobrašnjenoj površini razvaljaj tijesto na debljinu od oko 6 mm i modlicama ili nožem izreži oblike.
Složi kekse na pripremljeni lim, s malo razmaka između njih.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok rubovi ne porumene. Za hrskavije kekse ostavi ih da se hlade u pećnici s malo otvorenim vratima.
Izvadi kekse i prije posluživanja pusti da se potpuno ohlade na rešetki.

th: Keksi od kokosa i banane
p: Preheat oven to 163 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mash the banana until smooth.
Add coconut flour, unsweetened coconut flakes, egg, and melted coconut oil to the mashed banana. Mix until a dough forms. If too dry, add a little water.
Place dough between two sheets of parchment paper and roll to about 6 mm thickness.
Use a cookie cutter or knife to cut out shapes or squares from the dough.
Place biscuits on the baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden and firm.
Allow biscuits to cool completely on a wire rack before serving.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 163 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U zdjeli zgnječi bananu dok ne postane glatka.
Zgnječenoj banani dodaj kokosovo brašno, nezaslađene kokosove listiće, jaje i otopljeno kokosovo ulje. Miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto. Ako je presuho, dodaj malo vode.
Stavi tijesto između dva lista papira za pečenje i razvaljaj ga na debljinu od oko 6 mm.
Modlicom ili nožem izreži oblike ili kvadrate.
Složi kekse na lim i peci 20–25 minuta ili dok ne postanu zlatni i čvrsti.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se keksi potpuno ohlade na rešetki.

t: Sweet Potato, Beef & Green Bean Mash
th: Pire od batata, govedine i mahuna
i: 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
225 g fresh green beans, chopped into bite-sized pieces
120 g lean ground beef or turkey (optional)
p: Peel and cube the sweet potatoes, then place them in a pot with water and bring to a boil. Let cook for 15-20 minutes, or until soft enough to mash.
While sweet potatoes are cooking, wash and chop green beans into bite-sized pieces. Steam for 5-7 minutes until tender but still crunchy.
In a skillet over medium heat, cook the ground beef or turkey until fully browned, then drain any excess fat.
Once sweet potatoes are tender, drain water and mash them until smooth. Add in the green beans and cooked meat, mixing everything together well.
Serve with a sprinkle of fresh parsley if desired.
ih: 2 velika batata, oguljena i narezana na kocke
225 g svježih mahuna, narezanih na komadiće za jedan zalogaj
120 g nemasne mljevene govedine ili puretine (po želji)
ph: Oguli batat, nareži ga na kockice, stavi u lonac s vodom i zakuhaj. Kuhaj 15–20 minuta ili dok ne omekša toliko da se može zgnječiti.
Dok se batat kuha, operi mahune i nareži ih na komadiće za jedan zalogaj. Kuhaj ih na pari 5–7 minuta, dok ne omekšaju, ali ostanu hrskave.
U tavi na srednjoj vatri peci mljevenu govedinu ili puretinu dok potpuno ne posmeđi, pa ocijedi višak masnoće.
Kad batat omekša, ocijedi vodu i zgnječi ga u glatki pire. Dodaj mahune i pečeno meso i sve dobro promiješaj.
Po želji posluži posuto svježim peršinom.

th: Govedina s rižom i povrćem
i: 480 ml water or low-sodium beef broth
p: Rinse the rice under cold water to remove excess starch.
In a pot, bring 480 ml of water or low-sodium beef broth to a boil and add the rice.
Reduce the heat, cover, and let the rice simmer until fully cooked, about 15–20 minutes. Set aside to cool.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium heat until browned, stirring to break it up. Drain any excess fat.
Add diced carrots and peas to the skillet with the beef. Cook for 5–7 minutes, or until carrots are slightly softened.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir well to combine all ingredients evenly.
Allow the mixture to cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 480 ml vode ili goveđeg temeljca s malo soli
Po želji: svježi peršin za ukras
ph: Isperi rižu pod hladnom vodom da ukloniš višak škroba.
U loncu zakuhaj 480 ml vode ili goveđeg temeljca s malo soli i dodaj rižu.
Smanji vatru, poklopi i kuhaj rižu dok se potpuno ne skuha, oko 15–20 minuta. Ostavi je da se ohladi.
U velikoj tavi peci mljevenu govedinu na srednjoj vatri dok ne posmeđi, miješajući da se usitni. Ocijedi višak masnoće.
U tavu s govedinom dodaj kockice mrkve i grašak. Kuhaj 5–7 minuta ili dok mrkva malo ne omekša.
Dodaj kuhanu rižu u tavu i dobro promiješaj da se svi sastojci ravnomjerno sjedine.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se smjesa potpuno ohladi.

th: Zobeni kolutići s maslacem od kikirikija
i: 80 g rolled oats (or oat flour for a smoother texture)
p: Preheat oven to 165 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
If desired, pulse the rolled oats in a food processor to create oat flour for a smoother texture.
In a large bowl, mix the peanut butter, applesauce, and honey until smooth.
Gradually add the oats (or oat flour) to the mixture and stir until fully combined. The dough should be thick but workable.
Roll the dough out on a floured surface to 6 mm thickness. Use a cookie cutter or shape the dough into rounds by hand.
Place the rounds on the prepared baking sheet, spaced slightly apart.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.
Let the treats cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 80 g zobenih pahuljica (ili zobenog brašna za glađu teksturu)
130 g prirodnog maslaca od kikirikija (bez ksilitola)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 165 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
Po želji kratko izmiksaj zobene pahuljice u multipraktiku u zobeno brašno, za glađu teksturu.
U velikoj zdjeli miješaj maslac od kikirikija, pire od jabuke i med dok ne postane glatko.
Postupno dodaj zob (ili zobeno brašno) u smjesu i miješaj dok se potpuno ne sjedini. Tijesto treba biti gusto, ali da se s njim može raditi.
Razvaljaj tijesto na pobrašnjenoj površini na debljinu od 6 mm. Izreži ga modlicom ili rukama oblikuj krugove.
Složi krugove na pripremljeni lim, s malo razmaka između njih.
Peci 10–12 minuta ili dok ne porumene.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se poslastice potpuno ohlade.

th: Zalogajčići od jabuke i maslaca od kikirikija
i: 1 large apple (cored and chopped, skin on)
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Wash, core, and chop the apple into small pieces.
Blend oats in a food processor until they reach a flour-like consistency.
In a mixing bowl, combine chopped apple, peanut butter, ground oats, and cinnamon (if using).
Add water gradually, a tablespoon at a time, until the dough holds together.
Roll the dough into small, bite-sized balls or shape into mini cookies.
Place bites on the baking sheet and bake for 20–25 minutes until firm and lightly golden.
Let treats cool completely before serving or storing.
ih: 1 velika jabuka (bez sjemenki, nasjeckana, s korom)
130 g maslaca od kikirikija (bez šećera i ksilitola)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
Operi jabuku, ukloni sredinu i nasjeckaj je na male komade.
Izmiksaj zob u multipraktiku dok ne postane sitna poput brašna.
U zdjeli pomiješaj nasjeckanu jabuku, maslac od kikirikija, mljevenu zob i cimet (ako ga koristiš).
Postupno dodaj vodu, po jednu žlicu, dok se tijesto ne poveže.
Oblikuj tijesto u male kuglice za jedan zalogaj ili u mini kekse.
Složi zalogajčiće na lim i peci 20–25 minuta dok ne postanu čvrsti i lagano zlatni.
Prije posluživanja ili spremanja pusti da se poslastice potpuno ohlade.

th: Keksi od batata i sira
i: 1 large or 2 medium sweet potatoes, mashed
240 g whole wheat flour (or substitute with oat/almond flour)
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C.
Peel, cube, and boil sweet potatoes until soft, then mash until smooth.
In a large bowl, mix whole wheat flour and shredded cheese.
Add mashed sweet potato, egg, and coconut oil (and any optional ingredients), mixing until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough on a floured surface to 6 mm thickness and cut into shapes.
Place shapes on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Allow biscuits to cool completely before serving.
ih: 240 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili umjesto njega zobenog ili bademova brašna)
Po želji: 60 g pirea od bundeve
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
Oguli batat, nareži ga na kockice i skuhaj da omekša, pa ga zgnječi u glatki pire.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj integralno pšenično brašno i naribani sir.
Dodaj zgnječeni batat, jaje i kokosovo ulje (i dodatke po želji) i miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto.
Razvaljaj tijesto na pobrašnjenoj površini na debljinu od 6 mm i izreži oblike.
Složi oblike na lim obložen papirom za pečenje.
Peci 25–30 minuta dok ne porumene i ne postanu hrskavi.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se keksi potpuno ohlade.

th: Pitice od bundeve i jabuke
i: 65 g diced apple (peeled and chopped into small cubes)
90 g oat flour (plus more if needed for dough consistency)
p: In a mixing bowl, combine the oat flour and egg, stirring until a dough forms. If the dough is too sticky, add a bit more oat flour until it reaches a workable consistency.
Press small portions of the dough into mini muffin tins to form tart shells.
Preheat your oven to 175 °C. Pre-bake the tart shells for about 10 minutes until they start to firm up slightly, then remove from oven.
In a small saucepan over low heat, combine the pumpkin puree, diced apple, and cinnamon (if using). Cook for about 5 minutes, until the apples start to soften.
Spoon the pumpkin-apple filling into each tart shell. Return to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the filling is set and the shells are golden.
Allow the tarts to cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 65 g jabuke (oguljene i narezane na male kockice)
90 g zobenog brašna (i još po potrebi, za gustoću tijesta)
ph: U zdjeli pomiješaj zobeno brašno i jaje i miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto. Ako je tijesto previše ljepljivo, dodaj još malo zobenog brašna dok se s njim ne bude lako radilo.
Utisni male komade tijesta u kalup za mini muffine da dobiješ košarice za tartove.
Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C. Najprije peci prazne košarice oko 10 minuta, dok se malo ne stvrdnu, pa ih izvadi iz pećnice.
U malom loncu na laganoj vatri pomiješaj pire od bundeve, kockice jabuke i cimet (ako ga koristiš). Kuhaj oko 5 minuta, dok jabuka ne počne mekšati.
Žlicom napuni svaku košaricu nadjevom od bundeve i jabuke. Vrati u pećnicu i peci još 10–15 minuta ili dok se nadjev ne stegne, a košarice ne postanu zlatne.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se tartovi potpuno ohlade.

th: Kolačići od jabuke i zobi
i: 60 ml water or low-sodium chicken broth
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C and line a cupcake tin with silicone liners.
In a mixing bowl, combine the oat flour and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, applesauce, grated apple, and honey (if using).
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until fully incorporated. Add water or chicken broth if the batter is too thick.
Spoon the batter into the cupcake liners, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the cupcakes to cool completely.
For the frosting, mix Greek yogurt and peanut butter until smooth. Pipe or spread the frosting on the cooled cupcakes if desired.
Serve to your dog in moderation and enjoy watching them indulge!
ih: 60 g nezaslađenog pirea od jabuke (bez dodanog šećera)
½ žličice praška za pecivo (po želji)
60 ml vode ili pilećeg temeljca s malo soli
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i u kalup za kolačiće stavi silikonske košarice.
U zdjeli pomiješaj zobeno brašno i prašak za pecivo.
U drugoj zdjeli umuti jaje, pire od jabuke, naribanu jabuku i med (ako ga koristiš).
Ulij mokre sastojke u suhe i miješaj dok se potpuno ne sjedine. Ako je smjesa pregusta, dodaj vode ili pilećeg temeljca.
Žlicom rasporedi smjesu u košarice i napuni svaku do otprilike tri četvrtine.
Peci 18–20 minuta ili dok čačkalica zabodena u sredinu ne izađe čista. Pusti da se kolačići potpuno ohlade.
Za kremu miješaj grčki jogurt i maslac od kikirikija dok ne postane glatko. Po želji kremu istisni ili namaži na ohlađene kolačiće.
Posluži psu umjereno i uživaj gledajući kako se slasti!

th: Kolačići od piletine i mrkve
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C and line a muffin tin with paper liners or silicone molds.
In a large bowl, combine whole wheat flour and baking powder. Stir well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together applesauce, egg, and water. Add shredded chicken and grated carrots and mix well.
Pour the wet ingredients into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Spoon the batter into the muffin tin, filling each cup about 3/4 full.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let cupcakes cool completely on a wire rack before frosting.
For the frosting, mix Greek yogurt and unsweetened applesauce until smooth. Frost the cooled cupcakes and garnish with shredded carrots if desired.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i u kalup za muffine stavi papirnate ili silikonske košarice.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj integralno pšenično brašno i prašak za pecivo. Dobro promiješaj.
U drugoj zdjeli umuti pire od jabuke, jaje i vodu. Dodaj usitnjenu piletinu i naribanu mrkvu i dobro promiješaj.
Ulij mokre sastojke u zdjelu sa suhima i miješaj samo dok se ne sjedine.
Žlicom rasporedi tijesto u kalup za muffine, svaku košaricu do oko 3/4.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok čačkalica zabodena u sredinu ne izađe čista.
Prije premazivanja kremom pusti da se kolačići potpuno ohlade na rešetki.
Za kremu miješaj grčki jogurt i nezaslađeni pire od jabuke dok ne postane glatko. Premaži ohlađene kolačiće i po želji ukrasi naribanom mrkvom.

th: Keksi od jabuke i cheddara
i: 120 g whole wheat flour (or oat flour for gluten-free)
60 g unsweetened applesauce or 1 small grated apple (seeds removed)
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C.
In a large bowl, combine whole wheat flour, grated cheddar cheese, applesauce or grated apple, and egg. Mix until a dough forms. If too dry, add a tablespoon of water.
Place dough on a lightly floured surface and roll it out to about 6 mm thickness.
Use a cookie cutter to cut dough into desired shapes.
Arrange cut-out shapes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until biscuits turn golden brown.
Let biscuits cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 120 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili zobenog brašna za verziju bez glutena)
60 g nezaslađenog pirea od jabuke ili 1 mala naribana jabuka (bez sjemenki)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj integralno pšenično brašno, naribani cheddar, pire od jabuke ili naribanu jabuku i jaje. Miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto. Ako je presuho, dodaj žlicu vode.
Stavi tijesto na lagano pobrašnjenu površinu i razvaljaj ga na debljinu od oko 6 mm.
Modlicom izreži oblike po želji.
Složi izrezane oblike na lim obložen papirom za pečenje.
Peci 15–20 minuta ili dok keksi ne porumene.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se keksi potpuno ohlade.

th: Juha od govedine i ječma
i: 1.45 l low-sodium beef or chicken broth (or water)
p: In a large pot, heat a tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon. Drain any excess fat.
Pour in the 1.45 l of low-sodium broth or water.
Stir in the barley, diced carrots, celery, and green beans.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and let it simmer for about 45 minutes, or until the barley is tender and the vegetables are soft. Stir occasionally.
Remove from heat and let the soup cool to a safe temperature before serving it to your dog.
ih: 1,45 l goveđeg ili pilećeg temeljca s malo soli (ili vode)
ph: U velikom loncu na srednjoj vatri zagrij žlicu maslinova ulja. Dodaj mljevenu govedinu i peci je dok ne posmeđi, usitnjavajući je žlicom. Ocijedi višak masnoće.
Ulij 1,45 l temeljca s malo soli ili vode.
Umiješaj ječam, kockice mrkve, celer i mahune.
Zakuhaj, pa smanji vatru i kuhaj oko 45 minuta ili dok ječam i povrće ne omekšaju. Povremeno promiješaj.
Makni s vatre i prije posluživanja psu pusti da se juha ohladi na sigurnu temperaturu.

th: Žvakalice od puretine i brusnica
i: 455 g ground turkey (lean or extra lean)
80 g dried cranberries (unsweetened, no added sugar)
4 tbsp rolled oats (optional, for added fiber)
p: Preheat your oven to 163 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground turkey, dried cranberries, oats (if using), and the egg. Mix thoroughly until all ingredients are evenly distributed.
Add a tablespoon of coconut oil if the mixture feels dry.
Spread the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, pressing it down to an even thickness of about 6 mm–1.3 cm.
Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake for 20-30 minutes, or until the chews are firm and cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let the chews cool completely before cutting them into strips or bite-sized pieces.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week, or freeze for up to three months.
ih: 455 g mljevene puretine (nemasne ili vrlo nemasne)
80 g sušenih brusnica (nezaslađenih, bez dodanog šećera)
4 žlice zobenih pahuljica (po želji, za više vlakana)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 163 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje ili silikonskom podlogom.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj mljevenu puretinu, suhe brusnice, zob (ako je koristiš) i jaje. Dobro miješaj dok se svi sastojci ravnomjerno ne rasporede.
Ako je smjesa suha, dodaj žlicu kokosova ulja.
Rasporedi smjesu po pripremljenom limu i pritisni je na jednaku debljinu od oko 6 mm–1,3 cm.
Stavi lim u pećnicu i peci 20–30 minuta ili dok žvakalice ne postanu čvrste i potpuno pečene.
Izvadi iz pećnice i pusti da se potpuno ohladi, pa nareži na trake ili komadiće za jedan zalogaj.
Čuvaj u dobro zatvorenoj posudi u hladnjaku do tjedan dana ili u zamrzivaču do tri mjeseca.

th: Keksi od krumpira i sira
i: 55 g shredded cheese (mild varieties like cheddar or mozzarella)
120 g whole wheat flour (or oat flour)
1–2 tbsp of water (as needed for dough consistency)
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the mashed potato, shredded cheese, and egg.
Gradually add the flour, mixing until a thick, doughy consistency forms. Add water as needed to reach the right consistency.
Dust a surface with flour and roll out the dough to about 6 mm thickness.
Use a cookie cutter to cut the dough into shapes, then place on the baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and firm.
Allow the biscuits to cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 55 g naribanog sira (blagog, npr. cheddara ili mozzarelle)
120 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili zobenog brašna)
1–2 žlice vode (po potrebi, za gustoću tijesta)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj zgnječeni krumpir, naribani sir i jaje.
Postupno dodaj brašno i miješaj dok ne dobiješ gusto tijesto. Po potrebi dodaj vode za pravu gustoću.
Pobrašni površinu i razvaljaj tijesto na debljinu od oko 6 mm.
Modlicom izreži oblike i složi ih na lim.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok ne porumene i ne postanu čvrsti.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se keksi potpuno ohlade.

th: Smoothie od batata i maslaca od kikirikija
y: 1 large smoothie (2 servings for a medium dog)
i: 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cooked
110 g plain Greek yogurt (optional, for added creaminess)
60 ml water or unsweetened coconut water (for blending)
Ice cubes (optional, for a thicker texture)
p: Prepare the sweet potato by boiling, baking, or microwaving it until soft. Allow it to cool, then scoop out the flesh.
In a blender, add the cooked sweet potato, peanut butter, Greek yogurt (if using), and water or coconut water.
Blend until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed to ensure all ingredients are well combined.
For a thicker texture, add a few ice cubes and blend again.
Pour the smoothie into your dog’s bowl or serve in small, treat-sized portions. Enjoy watching your pup savor every bite!
ih: 2 žlice maslaca od kikirikija bez šećera (bez ksilitola)
110 g običnog grčkog jogurta (po želji, za kremastiju smjesu)
60 ml vode ili nezaslađene kokosove vode (za miksanje)
Kockice leda (po želji, za gušću teksturu)
ph: Skuhaj, ispeci ili u mikrovalnoj omekšaj batat. Pusti da se ohladi, pa žlicom izvadi meso.
U blender stavi kuhani batat, maslac od kikirikija, grčki jogurt (ako ga koristiš) i vodu ili kokosovu vodu.
Miksaj dok ne postane glatko i po potrebi sastruži smjesu sa stijenki da se svi sastojci dobro sjedine.
Za gušći napitak dodaj nekoliko kockica leda i ponovno izmiksaj.
Ulij smoothie u pseću zdjelicu ili ga posluži u malim porcijama, kao poslasticu. Uživaj gledajući kako psu prija svaki gutljaj!
yh: 1 veliki smoothie (2 porcije za srednjeg psa)

th: Mesna štruca od piletine i špinata
p: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground chicken, chopped spinach, oat flour, and egg. Mix thoroughly until well incorporated.
Preheat your oven to 175 °C. Grease a small loaf pan or line it with parchment paper. Spoon the chicken mixture into the pan, pressing down to make sure it’s even and compact.
Bake in the oven for 30-35 minutes, or until the meatloaf is firm and fully cooked (internal temperature should reach 75 °C).
Let it cool completely before slicing. Slice into dog-friendly portions and serve as a treat or meal.
ph: U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj mljevenu piletinu, nasjeckani špinat, zobeno brašno i jaje. Dobro miješaj dok se potpuno ne sjedine.
Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C. Namasti mali duguljasti kalup ili ga obloži papirom za pečenje. Žlicom stavi pileću smjesu u kalup i pritisni da bude ravna i zbijena.
Peci u pećnici 30–35 minuta ili dok mesna štruca ne postane čvrsta i potpuno pečena (temperatura u sredini treba dosegnuti 75 °C).
Prije rezanja pusti da se potpuno ohladi. Nareži na porcije prikladne za psa i posluži kao poslasticu ili obrok.

th: Štruca od lososa i batata
i: 455 g of salmon, cooked and flaked (or low-sodium canned salmon in water)
1 large sweet potato, cooked and mashed
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C and prepare a loaf pan by greasing it with a small amount of coconut oil or lining it with parchment paper.
If using fresh salmon, bake it at 175 °C for about 20 minutes until it flakes easily, then remove any bones. For canned salmon, ensure it’s low in sodium and drained well.
Cook the sweet potato until soft and mash it until smooth.
Grate the carrots and chop the parsley, if using.
In a large bowl, mix the flaked salmon, mashed sweet potato, egg, oat flour, parsley, grated carrots, and turmeric (if using) until all ingredients are well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the prepared loaf pan, pressing it down to remove air pockets and smooth the top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30–35 minutes, until the meatloaf is firm to the touch and lightly golden.
Allow the meatloaf to cool completely before slicing it into portions for your dog.
ih: 455 g lososa, kuhanog i razdijeljenog na listiće (ili lososa iz limenke u vodi, s malo soli)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i pripremi duguljasti kalup: namasti ga s malo kokosova ulja ili obloži papirom za pečenje.
Ako koristiš svježeg lososa, peci ga na 175 °C oko 20 minuta, dok se lako ne razdvaja na listiće, pa ukloni sve kosti. Losos iz konzerve neka bude s malo soli i dobro ocijeđen.
Skuhaj batat da omekša i zgnječi ga u glatki pire.
Naribaj mrkvu i nasjeckaj peršin, ako ga koristiš.
U velikoj zdjeli miješaj lososa razdvojenog na listiće, zgnječeni batat, jaje, zobeno brašno, peršin, naribanu mrkvu i kurkumu (ako je koristiš) dok se svi sastojci dobro ne sjedine.
Žlicom stavi smjesu u pripremljeni kalup, pritisni je da istisneš zrak i poravnaj vrh.
Peci u zagrijanoj pećnici 30–35 minuta, dok štruca ne postane čvrsta na dodir i lagano zlatna.
Pusti da se štruca potpuno ohladi, pa je nareži na porcije za psa.

th: Pločice od bundeve i maslaca od kikirikija
i: 120 g of oats (ground for a smoother texture, or leave whole for more chewiness)
Optional: A pinch of cinnamon (check with your vet if your dog is sensitive)
Optional: 1 tsp of honey for extra sweetness
p: Prepare your ingredients. If using whole oats, grind them into a powder using a food processor or blender for a smoother texture.
In a medium bowl, combine the pumpkin puree and peanut butter. Stir until smooth and well-mixed.
Gradually add the ground oats to the pumpkin-peanut butter mixture, stirring until you achieve a dough-like consistency. Add more oats if too sticky or a splash of water if too dry.
Line an 20 × 20 cm baking dish with parchment paper. Spread the mixture evenly in the dish, pressing down firmly to compact it.
Refrigerate for 1-2 hours (or freeze for 30-45 minutes) until firm.
Remove from the dish and cut into bite-sized squares.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week or in the freezer for up to three months.
ih: 240 g čistog pirea od bundeve (bez šećera)
120 g zobenih pahuljica (samljevenih za glađu teksturu ili cijelih da budu žilavije)
Po želji: prstohvat cimeta (ako je pas osjetljiv, pitaj veterinara)
Po želji: 1 žličica meda za slatkoću
ph: Pripremi sastojke. Ako koristiš cijelu zob, izmiksaj je u prah u multipraktiku ili blenderu, za glađu teksturu.
U srednjoj zdjeli pomiješaj pire od bundeve i maslac od kikirikija. Miješaj dok ne postane glatko i dobro sjedinjeno.
Postupno dodaj mljevenu zob u smjesu od bundeve i kikirikija i miješaj dok ne postane gusta poput tijesta. Ako je previše ljepljiva, dodaj još zobi, a ako je presuha, malo vode.
Obloži posudu za pečenje od 20 × 20 cm papirom za pečenje. Ravnomjerno rasporedi smjesu u posudu i čvrsto je pritisni da se zbije.
Stavi u hladnjak na 1–2 sata (ili u zamrzivač na 30–45 minuta) da se stvrdne.
Izvadi iz posude i nareži na kockice za jedan zalogaj.
Čuvaj u dobro zatvorenoj posudi u hladnjaku do tjedan dana ili u zamrzivaču do tri mjeseca.

th: Kolačići od piletine i brokule
p: Preheat the oven to 175 °C and line a muffin tin with cupcake liners.
Cook the chicken until fully done, then shred it into small pieces. Chop the broccoli florets into small pieces.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the pumpkin puree, applesauce, chicken broth, and egg, whisking until well mixed.
Fold in the shredded chicken and chopped broccoli until evenly distributed.
In a separate bowl, mix the oat flour with any optional ingredients, like flaxseed meal or grated carrot.
Slowly add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring until a thick batter forms. Add more chicken broth if the batter is too dry.
Divide the batter evenly among the cupcake liners, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the tops are golden and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow the cupcakes to cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 120 g pirea od bundeve (čistog, bez dodataka)
60 ml pilećeg temeljca s malo soli
Po želji: 1 žlica mljevenog lanenog sjemena
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i u kalup za muffine stavi papirnate košarice.
Skuhaj piletinu da bude potpuno gotova, pa je usitni na male komade. Nasjeckaj cvjetiće brokule na male komade.
U velikoj zdjeli umuti pire od bundeve, pire od jabuke, pileći temeljac i jaje dok se dobro ne sjedine.
Umiješaj usitnjenu piletinu i nasjeckanu brokulu tako da se ravnomjerno rasporede.
U drugoj zdjeli pomiješaj zobeno brašno s dodacima po želji, npr. mljevenim lanenim sjemenom ili naribanom mrkvom.
Polako dodaj suhe sastojke u mokru smjesu i miješaj dok ne dobiješ gustu smjesu. Ako je presuha, dodaj još pilećeg temeljca.
Ravnomjerno rasporedi smjesu u košarice i napuni svaku do otprilike tri četvrtine.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok vrhovi ne postanu zlatni, a čačkalica zabodena u sredinu ne izađe čista.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se kolačići potpuno ohlade.

th: Pizza od puretine i tikvica
i: 70 g ground turkey, cooked and crumbled
A few leaves of fresh parsley (optional)
p: Preheat the oven to 175 °C.
In a large mixing bowl, combine whole wheat flour, rolled oats, and water. Mix to form a dough, adding more water or flour as needed.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 2-3 minutes until smooth, then roll it out to about 6 mm thickness.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake for about 10 minutes to pre-bake the crust.
Cook the ground turkey in a pan over medium heat until fully cooked. Slice the zucchini into thin rounds.
Remove the pre-baked crust from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Top the crust with cooked turkey, arrange zucchini slices, and sprinkle a small amount of low-fat mozzarella on top.
Return the pizza to the oven and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, until the cheese melts and zucchini softens.
Allow the pizza to cool completely before cutting into bite-sized pieces for your dog.
ih: 70 g mljevene puretine, kuhane i usitnjene
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj integralno pšenično brašno, zobene pahuljice i vodu. Zamijesi tijesto, a po potrebi dodaj još vode ili brašna.
Mijesi tijesto na pobrašnjenoj površini 2–3 minute dok ne postane glatko, pa ga razvaljaj na debljinu od oko 6 mm.
Stavi tijesto na lim obložen papirom za pečenje i peci oko 10 minuta da se podloga prethodno ispeče.
Peci mljevenu puretinu u tavi na srednjoj vatri dok ne bude potpuno pečena. Nareži tikvicu na tanke kolutove.
Izvadi prethodno pečenu podlogu iz pećnice i pusti da se malo ohladi.
Na podlogu stavi pečenu puretinu, složi kolutove tikvice i pospi s malo posne mozzarelle.
Vrati pizzu u pećnicu i peci još 10–12 minuta, dok se sir ne otopi, a tikvica ne omekša.
Pusti da se pizza potpuno ohladi, pa je nareži na komadiće za jedan zalogaj.

th: Pečene poslastice od banane i maslaca od kikirikija
p: Preheat the oven to 175 °C.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour and salt.
Add the egg, peanut butter, and mashed bananas to the dry ingredients.
Gradually pour in the water, mixing until a firm, pliable dough forms.
On a floured surface, roll out the dough to about 6 mm thickness.
Using cookie cutters, cut the dough into desired shapes.
Place the cutouts on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Let the treats cool completely on a wire rack before serving to your dog.
ih: 260 g maslaca od kikirikija (neslanog, bez ksilitola)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj integralno pšenično brašno i sol.
Suhim sastojcima dodaj jaje, maslac od kikirikija i zgnječene banane.
Postupno ulijevaj vodu i miješaj dok ne dobiješ čvrsto, podatno tijesto.
Na pobrašnjenoj površini razvaljaj tijesto na debljinu od oko 6 mm.
Modlicama izreži oblike po želji.
Složi izrezane oblike na lim obložen papirom za pečenje.
Peci u zagrijanoj pećnici 15–20 minuta ili dok ne porumene.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se poslastice potpuno ohlade na rešetki.

th: Zalogajčići od mrkve i jabuke
i: 130 g grated apples (peeled, cored, and grated)
90 g oat flour (or oats ground into flour)
1 tbsp coconut oil (optional, for added healthy fats)
p: Begin by washing, peeling, and grating the carrots and apples. Remove the core and seeds from the apple as they can be harmful to dogs.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the grated carrots, grated apples, oat flour, coconut oil, and applesauce. Mix well until you have a thick, sticky dough.
Using your hands, form the mixture into small, bite-sized balls, approximately 2.5 cm in diameter.
(Optional) Preheat your oven to 175 °C. Place the bites on a lined baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until firm and lightly golden.
Allow the bites to cool completely before serving. Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge or freezer for longer storage.
ih: 90 g zobenog brašna (ili zobenih pahuljica samljevenih u brašno)
1 žlica kokosova ulja (po želji, za zdrave masnoće)
ph: Najprije operi, oguli i naribaj mrkvu i jabuke. Jabukama ukloni sredinu i sjemenke jer mogu naštetiti psu.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj naribanu mrkvu, naribane jabuke, zobeno brašno, kokosovo ulje i pire od jabuke. Dobro miješaj dok ne dobiješ gusto, ljepljivo tijesto.
Rukama oblikuj smjesu u male kuglice za jedan zalogaj, promjera oko 2,5 cm.
(Po želji) Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C. Složi zalogajčiće na obloženi lim i peci 20–25 minuta ili dok ne postanu čvrsti i lagano zlatni.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se zalogajčići potpuno ohlade. Ostatak čuvaj u dobro zatvorenoj posudi u hladnjaku, a za duže čuvanje u zamrzivaču.

th: Mesna štruca od batata i piletine
i: 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and diced
1 tbsp olive oil or coconut oil
p: Preheat the oven to 175 °C.
Boil the diced sweet potatoes for about 10 minutes or until soft. Drain and mash them lightly.
In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken, mashed sweet potatoes, oats, chopped carrots, peas (optional), and egg. Mix thoroughly.
Lightly grease a loaf pan with olive oil or coconut oil.
Press the mixture into the pan and bake for 45-60 minutes or until cooked through and firm.
Let the meatloaf cool completely before slicing into portions.
ih: 2 velika batata, oguljena i narezana na kockice
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
Kuhaj kockice batata oko 10 minuta ili dok ne omekšaju. Ocijedi ih i lagano zgnječi.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj mljevenu piletinu, zgnječeni batat, zob, nasjeckanu mrkvu, grašak (po želji) i jaje. Dobro promiješaj.
Lagano namasti duguljasti kalup maslinovim ili kokosovim uljem.
Utisni smjesu u kalup i peci 45–60 minuta ili dok ne bude potpuno pečena i čvrsta.
Pusti da se štruca potpuno ohladi, pa je nareži na porcije.

th: Zalogajčići od mrkve i piletine
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, grated carrots, rolled oats, and parsley.
Crack the egg into the bowl and mix well until all ingredients are fully incorporated.
Form the mixture into small bite-sized balls and place them on the baking sheet.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until firm and lightly golden.
Let the bites cool completely before serving.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj usitnjenu piletinu, naribanu mrkvu, zobene pahuljice i peršin.
Razbij jaje u zdjelu i dobro miješaj dok se svi sastojci potpuno ne sjedine.
Oblikuj smjesu u male kuglice za jedan zalogaj i složi ih na lim.
Peci 15–20 minuta ili dok ne postanu čvrste i lagano zlatne.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se zalogajčići potpuno ohlade.

th: Keksi od piletine i bundeve
i: 240 g canned pumpkin puree (unsweetened, no spices)
240 g whole wheat flour (or oat flour)
1 tbsp olive oil or coconut oil
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mix the shredded chicken, pumpkin puree, egg, and oil until combined.
Gradually add the flour and turmeric (if using) to form a dough.
Knead the dough and roll it out to about 6 mm thickness.
Use a cookie cutter to cut the dough into desired shapes.
Place on a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Let the biscuits cool completely before serving.
ih: 240 g pirea od bundeve iz limenke (bez šećera i začina)
240 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili zobenog brašna)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U velikoj zdjeli miješaj usitnjenu piletinu, pire od bundeve, jaje i ulje dok se ne sjedine.
Postupno dodaj brašno i kurkumu (ako je koristiš) da dobiješ tijesto.
Zamijesi tijesto i razvaljaj ga na debljinu od oko 6 mm.
Modlicom izreži oblike po želji.
Složi na lim i peci 25–30 minuta ili dok ne porumene.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se keksi potpuno ohlade.

th: Zalogajčići od batata, špinata i zobi
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Boil or steam the cubed sweet potatoes for 10-15 minutes until soft.
Mash sweet potatoes in a large bowl until smooth.
Sauté spinach in coconut oil for 2-3 minutes until wilted.
Add the spinach, egg, flaxseed meal (if using), and oat flour to the mashed sweet potatoes. Mix well.
Shape the mixture into patties or balls and place on the baking sheet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until firm and golden. Let cool before serving.
ih: 2 velika batata (oguljena i narezana na kocke)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C. Obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
Kuhaj kockice batata u vodi ili na pari 10–15 minuta dok ne omekšaju.
U velikoj zdjeli zgnječi batat u glatki pire.
Kratko prži špinat na kokosovu ulju 2–3 minute dok ne splasne.
Zgnječenom batatu dodaj špinat, jaje, mljeveno laneno sjeme (ako ga koristiš) i zobeno brašno. Dobro promiješaj.
Oblikuj smjesu u pljeskavice ili kuglice i složi ih na lim.
Peci 25–30 minuta dok ne postanu čvrste i zlatne. Prije posluživanja pusti da se ohlade.

th: Keksi od mrkve i zobi
i: 180 g whole wheat flour (or gluten-free alternative)
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C.
In a large bowl, mix oats and whole wheat flour.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg and combine with applesauce and grated carrots. Add honey if using.
Gradually fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients. Slowly add water as needed to create a workable dough.
Roll out the dough on a floured surface to 6 mm thickness.
Use cookie cutters to cut out shapes.
Place biscuits on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool completely on a wire rack before serving to your dog.
ih: 180 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili zamjene bez glutena)
120 ml vode (po potrebi, za gustoću tijesta)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj zob i integralno pšenično brašno.
U drugoj zdjeli umuti jaje i pomiješaj ga s pireom od jabuke i naribanom mrkvom. Ako ga koristiš, dodaj med.
Postupno umiješaj mokru smjesu u suhe sastojke. Po potrebi polako dodaj vode, da se s tijestom može raditi.
Razvaljaj tijesto na pobrašnjenoj površini na debljinu od 6 mm.
Modlicama izreži oblike.
Složi kekse na lim i peci 20–25 minuta ili dok ne porumene.
Prije posluživanja psu potpuno ohladi na rešetki.

th: Muffini od banane i batata
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C. Line a muffin tin with paper liners or lightly grease it.
In a large bowl, mash the banana and sweet potato.
Add eggs and peanut butter to the mashed mixture. Stir well.
In a separate bowl, mix oat flour, cinnamon, and baking powder.
Combine the wet and dry ingredients. Stir until a thick batter forms.
Spoon batter into muffin cups, filling them 3/4 full.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let the muffins cool completely before serving.
ih: 65 g prirodnog maslaca od kikirikija (bez ksilitola)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C. U kalup za muffine stavi papirnate košarice ili ga lagano namasti.
U velikoj zdjeli zgnječi bananu i batat.
Zgnječenoj smjesi dodaj jaja i maslac od kikirikija. Dobro promiješaj.
U drugoj zdjeli pomiješaj zobeno brašno, cimet i prašak za pecivo.
Sjedini mokre i suhe sastojke. Miješaj dok ne dobiješ gustu smjesu.
Žlicom rasporedi smjesu u košarice i napuni ih do 3/4.
Peci 25–30 minuta, dok čačkalica ne izađe čista.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se muffini potpuno ohlade.

th: Keksi od zobi, cheddara i jabuke, bez brašna
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C.
In a large bowl, mix rolled oats and shredded cheddar cheese.
In another bowl, whisk the egg and unsweetened applesauce (add olive oil if using).
Combine wet and dry ingredients to form a dough.
Roll dough into small balls or flatten into discs.
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the biscuits cool completely before serving to your dog.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj zobene pahuljice i naribani cheddar.
U drugoj zdjeli umuti jaje i nezaslađeni pire od jabuke (i maslinovo ulje, ako ga koristiš).
Sjedini mokre i suhe sastojke u tijesto.
Oblikuj tijesto u male kuglice ili ih spljošti u kolutiće.
Složi na lim obložen papirom za pečenje.
Peci 15–20 minuta ili dok ne porumene.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se keksi potpuno ohlade.

th: Zalogajčići od bundeve i piletine
i: 120 g pumpkin puree (not pumpkin pie filling)
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, pumpkin puree, rolled oats, flaxseed, shredded carrots, turmeric, egg, and melted coconut oil.
Mix until all the ingredients are well combined.
Form small balls (about 1 tbsp each) with your hands or a cookie scoop and place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until firm and golden brown.
Let the bites cool completely before serving them to your dog.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week, or freeze for longer storage.
ih: 120 g pirea od bundeve (ne nadjeva za pitu od bundeve)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj usitnjenu piletinu, pire od bundeve, zobene pahuljice, laneno sjeme, naribanu mrkvu, kurkumu, jaje i otopljeno kokosovo ulje.
Miješaj dok se svi sastojci dobro ne sjedine.
Rukama ili žlicom za kekse oblikuj male kuglice (svaka oko 1 žlica) i složi ih na lim obložen papirom za pečenje.
Peci 20–25 minuta dok ne postanu čvrste i ne porumene.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se zalogajčići potpuno ohlade.
Čuvaj u dobro zatvorenoj posudi u hladnjaku do tjedan dana ili zamrzni za duže čuvanje.

th: Keksi od slanine i maslaca od kikirikija
p: Preheat the oven to 175 °C.
Cook bacon until crispy, then chop into small pieces.
In a bowl, mix whole wheat flour and rolled oats.
Add peanut butter, egg, and water. Stir until a dough forms.
Fold in the bacon bits.
Roll dough to 6 mm thickness and cut out biscuit shapes.
Place on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, until golden.
Let cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 130 g potpuno prirodnog maslaca od kikirikija (bez ksilitola)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
Ispeci slaninu da postane hrskava, pa je nasjeckaj na male komade.
U zdjeli pomiješaj integralno pšenično brašno i zobene pahuljice.
Dodaj maslac od kikirikija, jaje i vodu. Miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto.
Umiješaj komadiće slanine.
Razvaljaj tijesto na debljinu od 6 mm i izreži kekse.
Složi na lim i peci 15–20 minuta, dok ne postanu zlatni.
Prije posluživanja psu potpuno ohladi.

th: Pljeskavice od lososa i batata
i: 1 large salmon fillet (boneless, skinless, about 455 g)
Optional: 30 g shredded carrots, 1 tbsp ground flaxseed
p: Cook sweet potatoes: Microwave for 6-8 minutes or bake at 205 °C for 45 minutes. Cool, peel, and mash.
Cook salmon: In a pan with water over medium heat, cook until opaque, about 5-7 minutes. Flake and check for bones.
Mix ingredients: In a bowl, combine mashed sweet potatoes, flaked salmon, egg, flour, and parsley (plus optional add-ins).
Form patties: Shape mixture into golf-ball-sized balls, flatten into patties.
Cook: Heat coconut oil in a skillet. Cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden. Cool before serving.
ih: 1 veliki file lososa (bez kostiju i kože, oko 455 g)
¼ žličice kurkume u prahu (po želji)
Po želji: 30 g naribane mrkve, 1 žlica mljevenog lanenog sjemena
ph: Skuhaj batat: u mikrovalnoj 6–8 minuta ili u pećnici na 205 °C 45 minuta. Ohladi ga, oguli i zgnječi.
Skuhaj lososa: u tavi s vodom na srednjoj vatri kuhaj ga dok ne postane neproziran, oko 5–7 minuta. Razdvoji ga na listiće i provjeri ima li kostiju.
Pomiješaj sastojke: u zdjeli sjedini zgnječeni batat, lososa razdvojenog na listiće, jaje, brašno i peršin (i dodatke po želji).
Oblikuj pljeskavice: od smjese napravi kuglice veličine loptice za golf i spljošti ih.
Ispeci: zagrij kokosovo ulje u tavi. Peci pljeskavice 3–4 minute sa svake strane, dok ne porumene. Prije posluživanja ohladi.

th: Žvakalice od bundeve i jabuke
i: 200 g oats (rolled or quick oats, blended into flour if desired)
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl, combine pumpkin puree and grated apple. Stir in honey if using.
Gradually mix in oats until dough forms.
Spread the mixture evenly on the lined baking sheet, about 6 mm thick.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until the edges are golden and firm.
Let the chews cool completely, then cut into bite-sized squares.
ih: 240 g pirea od bundeve (čistog, bez šećera)
1 velika jabuka (oguljena, bez sjemenki i naribana)
200 g zobenih pahuljica (običnih ili instant, po želji samljevenih u brašno)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C. Obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U zdjeli pomiješaj pire od bundeve i naribanu jabuku. Ako ga koristiš, umiješaj med.
Postupno umiješaj zob dok ne dobiješ tijesto.
Ravnomjerno rasporedi smjesu po obloženom limu, debljine oko 6 mm.
Peci 25–30 minuta dok rubovi ne postanu zlatni i čvrsti.
Pusti da se potpuno ohladi, pa nareži na kockice za jedan zalogaj.

th: Hrskavi čips od bundeve i maslaca od kikirikija
i: 240 g whole wheat flour (or oat flour for gluten-free)
1 tbsp olive oil (optional for added crunch)
p: Preheat the oven to 175 °C. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl, combine pumpkin puree and peanut butter. Stir until smooth.
Gradually add the flour, mixing continuously until the dough forms. If needed, add a little water.
Roll the dough on a floured surface to 6 mm thickness.
Use a knife or cookie cutter to shape the dough into small chips.
Place the chips on the baking sheet, leaving space between each one.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and crisp.
Let the chips cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 240 g pirea od bundeve (čistog, bez dodataka)
130 g prirodnog maslaca od kikirikija (bez šećera i soli)
240 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili zobenog brašna za verziju bez glutena)
1 žlica maslinova ulja (po želji, za hrskavost)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C. Obloži dva lima papirom za pečenje.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj pire od bundeve i maslac od kikirikija. Miješaj dok ne postane glatko.
Postupno dodaj brašno i neprestano miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto. Po potrebi dodaj malo vode.
Razvaljaj tijesto na pobrašnjenoj površini na debljinu od 6 mm.
Nožem ili modlicom izreži tijesto na male čipseve.
Složi čipseve na lim, s razmakom između njih.
Peci 20–25 minuta dok ne postanu zlatni i hrskavi.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se čipsevi potpuno ohlade.

th: Čips od banane i maslaca od kikirikija
p: Preheat your oven to 163 °C.
In a large bowl, mash the bananas until smooth.
Add peanut butter to the mashed bananas and stir well.
Gradually mix in the oat flour until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough between two sheets of parchment paper to about 3 mm thickness.
Cut the dough into small shapes using a cookie cutter or knife.
Place the cut-out chips on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Let the chips cool completely before serving.
ih: 65 g potpuno prirodnog maslaca od kikirikija (bez ksilitola)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 163 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli zgnječi banane dok ne postanu glatke.
Zgnječenim bananama dodaj maslac od kikirikija i dobro promiješaj.
Postupno umiješaj zobeno brašno dok ne dobiješ tijesto.
Razvaljaj tijesto između dva lista papira za pečenje na debljinu od oko 3 mm.
Modlicom ili nožem izreži male oblike.
Složi izrezane čipseve na lim obložen papirom za pečenje.
Peci 15–20 minuta ili dok ne porumene i ne postanu hrskavi.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se čipsevi potpuno ohlade.

th: Žvakalice od batata i borovnica
i: 160 g mashed sweet potato (cooked and cooled)
p: In a bowl, mix the mashed sweet potato, oats, and cinnamon until well combined.
Gently fold in the blueberries, ensuring even distribution throughout the mixture.
Roll the mixture into small bite-sized balls or shape into chews based on your dog’s size.
Place the chews on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Freeze the chews for 1-2 hours until firm.
Once frozen, transfer the chews to an airtight container and store them in the freezer for up to two weeks.
ph: U zdjeli miješaj zgnječeni batat, zob i cimet dok se dobro ne sjedine.
Lagano umiješaj borovnice tako da se ravnomjerno rasporede po smjesi.
Oblikuj smjesu u male kuglice za jedan zalogaj ili žvakalice prema veličini psa.
Složi žvakalice na lim obložen papirom za pečenje.
Zamrzni žvakalice 1–2 sata da se stvrdnu.
Kad se smrznu, prebaci ih u dobro zatvorenu posudu i čuvaj u zamrzivaču do dva tjedna.

th: Piletina s cvjetačom i graškom
p: Boil the chicken breasts in a pot of water for 15-20 minutes, until fully cooked. Let cool and then shred or dice into bite-sized pieces.
Steam the cauliflower, carrots, and peas until tender (5-7 minutes). Drain thoroughly.
In a large bowl, combine the chicken with the steamed vegetables. Drizzle with olive oil (optional) and stir well.
Let the mixture cool completely before serving. Store leftovers in the fridge for up to five days or freeze for future use.
ih: 2 pileća prsa bez kostiju i kože
ph: Kuhaj pileća prsa u loncu s vodom 15–20 minuta, dok se potpuno ne skuhaju. Pusti da se ohlade, pa ih usitni ili nareži na kockice za jedan zalogaj.
Kuhaj cvjetaču, mrkvu i grašak na pari dok ne omekšaju (5–7 minuta). Dobro ocijedi.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj piletinu s povrćem kuhanim na pari. Po želji prelij maslinovim uljem i dobro promiješaj.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se smjesa potpuno ohladi. Ostatak čuvaj u hladnjaku do pet dana ili ga zamrzni.

th: Žvakalice od banane i bundeve
i: 30 g whole wheat flour (or gluten-free alternative)
p: Preheat the oven to 150 °C.
In a mixing bowl, mash the ripe banana until smooth.
Stir in the pumpkin puree and peanut butter until well combined.
Add the oats and flour, mixing until a thick dough forms.
Roll the dough to 6 mm thickness on a floured surface.
Cut into rectangular bars or use cookie cutters to create fun shapes.
Place the bars on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until firm and golden.
Let cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 120 g čistog pirea od bundeve (bez začina)
30 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili zamjene bez glutena)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 150 °C.
U zdjeli zgnječi zrelu bananu dok ne postane glatka.
Umiješaj pire od bundeve i maslac od kikirikija dok se dobro ne sjedine.
Dodaj zob i brašno i miješaj dok ne dobiješ gusto tijesto.
Razvaljaj tijesto na pobrašnjenoj površini na debljinu od 6 mm.
Nareži ga na pravokutne pločice ili modlicama izreži zabavne oblike.
Složi pločice na lim obložen papirom za pečenje.
Peci 25–30 minuta dok ne postanu čvrste i zlatne.
Prije posluživanja psu potpuno ohladi.

th: Keksi od sira i jabuke
i: 55 g shredded cheese (cheddar or any dog-safe cheese)
65 g apple (peeled, cored, and finely diced)
90 g oat flour (or whole wheat flour)
1 tbsp olive oil (optional, for added moisture)
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine shredded cheese and diced apples.
Add oat flour, egg, and olive oil (if using). Stir until dough forms.
Roll out dough to 6 mm thickness. Cut into shapes using a cookie cutter.
Place biscuits on baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden and firm.
Let cool completely before serving.
ih: 55 g naribanog sira (cheddara ili drugog sira sigurnog za pse)
65 g jabuke (oguljene, bez sjemenki i sitno narezane na kockice)
90 g zobenog brašna (ili integralnog pšeničnog brašna)
1 žlica maslinova ulja (po želji, za vlažnost)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U zdjeli pomiješaj naribani sir i kockice jabuke.
Dodaj zobeno brašno, jaje i maslinovo ulje (ako ga koristiš). Miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto.
Razvaljaj tijesto na debljinu od 6 mm. Modlicom izreži oblike.
Složi kekse na lim i peci 15–20 minuta ili dok ne postanu zlatni i čvrsti.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se potpuno ohlade.

th: Muffini od bundeve i maslaca od kikirikija
p: Preheat the oven to 175 °C and line a muffin tin with paper liners or grease lightly.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pumpkin puree, peanut butter, and eggs until smooth.
Gradually stir in the whole wheat flour and baking powder until well combined.
Optionally, mix in the ground flaxseed, honey, and cinnamon for added flavor and nutrition.
Scoop the batter into the muffin cups, filling each about ¾ full.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let the muffins cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 130 g prirodnog maslaca od kikirikija (bez ksilitola)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i u kalup za muffine stavi papirnate košarice ili ga lagano namasti.
U velikoj zdjeli umuti pire od bundeve, maslac od kikirikija i jaja dok ne postane glatko.
Postupno umiješaj integralno pšenično brašno i prašak za pecivo dok se dobro ne sjedine.
Po želji umiješaj mljeveno laneno sjeme, med i cimet za bolji okus i hranjivost.
Rasporedi smjesu u košarice i napuni svaku do oko ¾.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok čačkalica zabodena u sredinu ne izađe čista.
Izvadi iz pećnice i prije posluživanja psu pusti da se muffini potpuno ohlade.

th: Muffini od bundeve i jabuke
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C and line a muffin tray with liners.
In a bowl, mix the pumpkin puree, eggs, and honey.
Fold in the diced apples.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and cinnamon.
Slowly add dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring until smooth. Add water as needed.
Spoon the batter into the muffin tin, filling each ¾ full.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Let muffins cool before serving to your dog.
ih: 1 jabuka, oguljena i narezana na kockice
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i u kalup za muffine stavi košarice.
U zdjeli pomiješaj pire od bundeve, jaja i med.
Umiješaj kockice jabuke.
U drugoj zdjeli izmiješaj brašno, sodu bikarbonu i cimet.
Polako dodaj suhe sastojke u mokru smjesu i miješaj dok ne postane glatko. Po potrebi dodaj vode.
Žlicom rasporedi smjesu u kalup za muffine i napuni svako udubljenje do ¾.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok zabodena čačkalica ne izađe čista.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se muffini ohlade.

th: Pire od puretine, batata i graška
i: 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
p: Peel and cube the sweet potatoes, then boil them for 15–20 minutes until soft. Set aside.
In a skillet, heat olive oil (if using) and cook the ground turkey until fully browned.
In the last 3 minutes of cooking, add peas and stir to heat them through.
Mash the sweet potatoes in a large bowl, then mix in the cooked turkey and peas.
Allow to cool before serving. Store leftovers in the fridge for 3 days or freeze for up to 3 months.
ih: 2 srednja batata, oguljena i narezana na kocke
ph: Oguli batat, nareži ga na kockice i kuhaj 15–20 minuta da omekša. Ostavi sa strane.
U tavi zagrij maslinovo ulje (ako ga koristiš) i peci mljevenu puretinu dok potpuno ne posmeđi.
U zadnje 3 minute dodaj grašak i promiješaj da se zagrije.
U velikoj zdjeli zgnječi batat, pa umiješaj pečenu puretinu i grašak.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se ohladi. Ostatak čuvaj u hladnjaku 3 dana ili u zamrzivaču do 3 mjeseca.

th: Muffini od mrkve i jabuke
p: Preheat the oven to 175 °C and grease or line a muffin tin.
Grate the carrot and apple, removing the apple core and seeds.
In a large bowl, mix the grated carrot, grated apple, rolled oats, applesauce, and egg until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the muffin tin, filling each cup two-thirds full.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow muffins to cool completely before serving to your dog.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i namasti kalup za muffine ili u njega stavi košarice.
Naribaj mrkvu i jabuku, a jabuci ukloni sredinu i sjemenke.
U velikoj zdjeli miješaj naribanu mrkvu, naribanu jabuku, zobene pahuljice, pire od jabuke i jaje dok se dobro ne sjedine.
Žlicom rasporedi smjesu u kalup za muffine i napuni svako udubljenje do dvije trećine.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok čačkalica zabodena u sredinu ne izađe čista.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se muffini potpuno ohlade.

th: Kolačići od zobi i malina
i: 65 g natural peanut butter (unsweetened, without xylitol)
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine rolled oats, mashed raspberries, banana, and peanut butter.
Scoop spoonfuls of the mixture onto the baking sheet and flatten slightly into cookie shapes.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, until golden brown.
Let cool completely before serving.
ih: 65 g prirodnog maslaca od kikirikija (bez šećera i ksilitola)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj zobene pahuljice, zgnječene maline, bananu i maslac od kikirikija.
Žlicom stavljaj smjesu na lim i malo je spljošti u oblik keksa.
Peci 15–20 minuta, dok ne porumene.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se potpuno ohlade.

th: Jogurt s bundevom
p: In a medium-sized bowl, combine the plain yogurt and pumpkin purée.
Mix until well combined or loosely swirl for a marbled effect.
Serve fresh immediately as a tasty snack or pour the mixture into silicone molds and freeze for a longer-lasting, refreshing treat.
ph: U srednjoj zdjeli pomiješaj obični jogurt i pire od bundeve.
Dobro izmiješaj ili samo lagano zavrtloži za mramorni uzorak.
Posluži odmah kao ukusnu grickalicu ili ulij smjesu u silikonske kalupe i zamrzni za osvježavajuću poslasticu koja dulje traje.

th: Muffini od piletine i jabuke
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C and line a muffin tin with paper liners or lightly grease.
In a large bowl, mix shredded chicken, applesauce, whole wheat flour, and egg until combined.
Spoon the mixture into muffin tins, filling each about 2/3 full.
Bake for 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let muffins cool completely before serving to your dog.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i u kalup za muffine stavi papirnate košarice ili ga lagano namasti.
U velikoj zdjeli miješaj usitnjenu piletinu, pire od jabuke, integralno pšenično brašno i jaje dok se ne sjedine.
Žlicom rasporedi smjesu u kalup za muffine i napuni svako udubljenje do oko 2/3.
Peci 20 minuta ili dok čačkalica ne izađe čista.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se muffini potpuno ohlade.

th: Zalogajčići od jogurta i maslaca od kikirikija
p: In a bowl, mix the plain yogurt and peanut butter until smooth.
Spoon the mixture into silicone molds or an ice cube tray.
Freeze for 2-4 hours, or until solid.
Once frozen, pop the treats out of the molds and store them in an airtight container in the freezer.
Serve to your dog as a cool, refreshing snack.
ih: 2 žlice maslaca od kikirikija (neslanog, bez ksilitola)
ph: U zdjeli miješaj obični jogurt i maslac od kikirikija dok ne postane glatko.
Žlicom rasporedi smjesu u silikonske kalupe ili posudu za led.
Zamrzni 2–4 sata ili dok se ne stvrdne.
Kad se smrznu, istisni poslastice iz kalupa i čuvaj ih u dobro zatvorenoj posudi u zamrzivaču.
Posluži psu kao hladnu, osvježavajuću grickalicu.

th: Hrskavi čips od jabuke s cimetom
p: Preheat oven to 95 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Wash and core the apples, then slice them thinly, about 3 mm thick.
Arrange the apple slices in a single layer on the baking sheet.
Sprinkle the cinnamon evenly over the apple slices.
Bake for 2-3 hours, flipping halfway, until the chips are crispy.
Let the chips cool completely before serving to your dog.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 95 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
Operi jabuke, ukloni im sredinu i nareži ih na tanke kriške, debljine oko 3 mm.
Složi kriške jabuke u jedan sloj na lim.
Ravnomjerno pospi kriške jabuke cimetom.
Peci 2–3 sata, a na pola vremena ih okreni, dok čips ne postane hrskav.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se čipsevi potpuno ohlade.

th: Žvakalice od govedine i mrkve
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mix ground beef, grated carrot, and whole wheat flour until combined.
Shape the mixture into small chews and place them on the baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until firm and cooked through.
Allow the chews to cool completely before serving.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U velikoj zdjeli miješaj mljevenu govedinu, naribanu mrkvu i integralno pšenično brašno dok se ne sjedine.
Oblikuj smjesu u male žvakalice i složi ih na lim.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok ne postanu čvrste i potpuno pečene.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se žvakalice potpuno ohlade.

th: Poslastice od mrkve i bundeve
p: Preheat oven to 175 °C.
In a large mixing bowl, combine grated carrot, pumpkin puree, rolled oats, coconut flour, and egg. Mix thoroughly.
Form the mixture into bite-sized balls and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until firm and lightly golden.
Cool completely before serving to your dog.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj naribanu mrkvu, pire od bundeve, zobene pahuljice, kokosovo brašno i jaje. Dobro promiješaj.
Oblikuj smjesu u kuglice za jedan zalogaj i složi ih na lim obložen papirom za pečenje.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok ne postanu čvrste i lagano zlatne.
Prije posluživanja psu potpuno ohladi.

th: Zalogajčići od mrkve i borovnica
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C.
In a mixing bowl, combine grated carrots, blueberries, rolled oats, applesauce, and egg. Mix well until everything is evenly incorporated.
Form the mixture into bite-sized shapes, or use a bone-shaped cookie cutter for added fun.
Place the shaped treats on a parchment-lined baking sheet, ensuring there’s space between each one.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until firm and slightly golden.
Allow the bites to cool completely before giving them to your dog.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U zdjeli pomiješaj naribanu mrkvu, borovnice, zobene pahuljice, pire od jabuke i jaje. Dobro miješaj dok se sve ravnomjerno ne sjedini.
Oblikuj smjesu u komadiće za jedan zalogaj ili, za više zabave, upotrijebi modlicu u obliku kosti.
Složi poslastice na lim obložen papirom za pečenje, s razmakom između njih.
Peci u zagrijanoj pećnici 20–25 minuta ili dok ne postanu čvrste i lagano zlatne.
Pusti da se zalogajčići potpuno ohlade prije nego što ih daš psu.

th: Muffini od puretine i mrkve
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground turkey, grated carrots, egg, and rolled oats. Mix until all ingredients are well incorporated.
Lightly grease the muffin tin or line it with silicone muffin cups.
Spoon the mixture evenly into each muffin cup, filling about three-quarters full.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until muffins are firm and cooked through. Use a toothpick to test doneness.
Allow the muffins to cool completely before serving.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj mljevenu puretinu, naribanu mrkvu, jaje i zobene pahuljice. Miješaj dok se svi sastojci dobro ne sjedine.
Lagano namasti kalup za muffine ili u njega stavi silikonske košarice.
Žlicom ravnomjerno rasporedi smjesu u košarice i napuni ih do otprilike tri četvrtine.
Peci 25 minuta ili dok muffini ne postanu čvrsti i potpuno pečeni. Čačkalicom provjeri jesu li gotovi.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se muffini potpuno ohlade.

th: Kuglice od puretine i bundeve
i: 120 g pumpkin purée (not pumpkin pie filling)
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the ground turkey, pumpkin purée, rolled oats, grated carrots, beaten egg, and optional garlic powder and parsley. Mix until well combined.
Scoop out small portions of the mixture and roll them into golf ball-sized balls, placing them on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the balls are cooked through and golden.
Allow the turkey & pumpkin balls to cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 120 g pirea od bundeve (ne nadjeva za pitu od bundeve)
¼ žličice češnjaka u prahu (po želji)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj mljevenu puretinu, pire od bundeve, zobene pahuljice, naribanu mrkvu, razmućeno jaje te po želji češnjak u prahu i peršin. Miješaj dok se dobro ne sjedine.
Uzimaj male dijelove smjese, oblikuj kuglice veličine loptice za golf i slaži ih na pripremljeni lim.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok kuglice ne budu potpuno pečene i zlatne.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se kuglice od puretine i bundeve potpuno ohlade.

th: Varivo od govedine i bundeve
p: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the lean ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Stir in the chopped carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes, allowing them to soften.
Add the pumpkin purée, peas, and low-sodium beef broth to the pot. Stir well to combine all the ingredients evenly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat and cook for 25-30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
If using dried parsley, sprinkle it on top after cooking.
Allow the stew to cool completely before serving to your dog.
ih: 480 ml goveđeg temeljca s malo soli
ph: U velikom loncu na srednjoj vatri zagrij maslinovo ulje. Dodaj posnu mljevenu govedinu i peci je dok ne posmeđi, usitnjavajući je.
Umiješaj nasjeckanu mrkvu i kuhaj još 5 minuta da omekša.
U lonac dodaj pire od bundeve, grašak i goveđi temeljac s malo soli. Dobro promiješaj da se svi sastojci ravnomjerno sjedine.
Pusti da lagano zavrije, pa smanji vatru i kuhaj 25–30 minuta ili dok povrće ne omekša.
Ako koristiš sušeni peršin, pospi ga po vrhu nakon kuhanja.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se varivo potpuno ohladi.

th: Žvakalice od mrkve i bundeve
p: Preheat your oven to 120 °C.
Peel the carrots and slice them lengthwise into thin strips, about 6 mm thick.
In a large bowl, combine carrot strips with pumpkin puree and olive oil. Mix until coated evenly.
Arrange the coated carrot strips on a parchment-lined baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake in the preheated oven for 2-3 hours, flipping halfway through, until the carrots are dried and chewy.
Let the carrot chews cool completely before serving them to your dog.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 120 °C.
Oguli mrkvu i nareži je po dužini na tanke trake, debljine oko 6 mm.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj trake mrkve s pireom od bundeve i maslinovim uljem. Miješaj dok se ravnomjerno ne oblože.
Složi obložene trake mrkve u jedan sloj na lim obložen papirom za pečenje.
Peci u zagrijanoj pećnici 2–3 sata, a na pola vremena ih okreni, dok mrkva ne postane suha i žilava.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se žvakalice od mrkve potpuno ohlade.

th: Duhovi od bundeve i mrkve za Noć vještica
y: 20-25 chews (depending on the size of the cutter)
i: 180 g whole wheat flour (or oat flour for a gluten-free option)
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the pumpkin puree, grated carrot, and egg. Gradually add the flour, mixing until a dough forms. If the dough is too sticky, add more flour as needed.
Chill the dough for 15-20 minutes to make it easier to handle.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to about 6 mm thickness. Use a ghost-shaped cookie cutter to cut out the chews and place them on the lined baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the chews are firm and lightly golden.
Allow the chews to cool completely before serving them to your dog.
ih: 180 g integralnog pšeničnog brašna (ili zobenog brašna za verziju bez glutena)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C. Obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj pire od bundeve, naribanu mrkvu i jaje. Postupno dodaj brašno i miješaj dok ne dobiješ tijesto. Ako je tijesto previše ljepljivo, po potrebi dodaj još brašna.
Ohladi tijesto 15–20 minuta da se s njim lakše radi.
Razvaljaj tijesto na lagano pobrašnjenoj površini na debljinu od oko 6 mm. Modlicom u obliku duha izreži žvakalice i složi ih na obloženi lim.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok žvakalice ne postanu čvrste i lagano zlatne.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se žvakalice potpuno ohlade.

th: Poslastice od jabuke i bundeve za Noć vještica
i: (Ensure it’s not pumpkin pie filling, which contains harmful additives.)
(Quick oats also work as an alternative.)
(Remember to core and remove the seeds.)
(Ensure it’s natural and unsweetened for safety.)
p: Preheat the oven to 175 °C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl, combine pumpkin puree, oats, chopped apples, and peanut butter. Stir well until the ingredients are evenly mixed.
Scoop small mounds of the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet using a spoon or ice cream scoop. Flatten each mound slightly with the back of a spoon.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the treats are firm to the touch.
Let the treats cool completely on a wire rack before serving.
ih: (Pazi da to nije nadjev za pitu od bundeve, koji ima štetne dodatke.)
1 žlica maslaca od kikirikija bez ksilitola
(Zbog sigurnosti neka bude prirodan i bez šećera.)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C. Obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U zdjeli pomiješaj pire od bundeve, zob, nasjeckane jabuke i maslac od kikirikija. Dobro miješaj dok se sastojci ravnomjerno ne sjedine.
Žlicom ili žlicom za sladoled stavljaj male hrpice smjese na pripremljeni lim. Svaku hrpicu malo spljošti poleđinom žlice.
Peci u zagrijanoj pećnici 20–25 minuta ili dok poslastice ne postanu čvrste na dodir.
Prije posluživanja pusti da se poslastice potpuno ohlade na rešetki.

th: Složenac od piletine i riže
i: 280 g cooked chicken breast (shredded, no seasoning)
600 ml low-sodium chicken broth (onion and garlic-free)
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the uncooked brown rice, chopped carrots, green peas, and chopped spinach. Stir well.
Add the shredded chicken to the bowl and pour in the low-sodium chicken broth. Mix until all ingredients are combined.
Pour the mixture into a casserole dish and spread it out evenly.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the rice is fully cooked and the vegetables are tender.
Allow the casserole to cool completely before serving it to your dog.
ih: 280 g kuhanih pilećih prsa (usitnjenih, bez začina)
600 ml pilećeg temeljca s malo soli (bez luka i češnjaka)
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C.
U velikoj zdjeli pomiješaj nekuhanu smeđu rižu, nasjeckanu mrkvu, zeleni grašak i nasjeckani špinat. Dobro promiješaj.
Dodaj usitnjenu piletinu i ulij pileći temeljac s malo soli. Miješaj dok se svi sastojci ne sjedine.
Prebaci smjesu u vatrostalnu posudu i ravnomjerno je rasporedi.
Pokrij posudu aluminijskom folijom i peci 45–50 minuta ili dok riža ne bude potpuno kuhana, a povrće mekano.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se jelo potpuno ohladi.

th: Keksi od mrkve i bundeve
p: Preheat your oven to 175 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium-sized mixing bowl, combine the pumpkin purée, grated carrots, rolled oats, and egg. Stir until all the ingredients are well mixed.

Scoop portions of the mixture onto the parchment-lined baking sheet and flatten slightly with a spoon. Alternatively, roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface and use a cookie cutter to create fun shapes.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the treats are firm and lightly golden. If thicker, bake an additional 5 minutes.
Let the treats cool completely on a wire rack before serving them to your pup.
ph: Zagrij pećnicu na 175 °C i obloži lim papirom za pečenje.
U srednjoj zdjeli pomiješaj pire od bundeve, naribanu mrkvu, zobene pahuljice i jaje. Miješaj dok se svi sastojci dobro ne sjedine.
Žlicom stavljaj dijelove smjese na lim obložen papirom za pečenje i malo ih spljošti. Možeš i razvaljati tijesto na lagano pobrašnjenoj površini i modlicom izrezati zabavne oblike.
Peci 20–25 minuta ili dok poslastice ne postanu čvrste i lagano zlatne. Ako su deblje, peci još 5 minuta.
Prije posluživanja psu pusti da se poslastice potpuno ohlade na rešetki.

th: Juha od bundeve i piletine
i: 960 ml low-sodium chicken broth (ensure it’s onion and garlic-free)
p: In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a boil. Add chicken breasts and cook for 15-20 minutes until fully cooked. Remove and shred.
Add chopped carrot and peas to the pot and let simmer for 10-15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in pumpkin purée and shredded chicken. Let it simmer for another 5-10 minutes to blend flavors.
